# Ibrahim Hussein — Computer Engineer & AI Developer

> Award-winning Computer Engineering student from Kurdistan Region, Iraq. Co-founder of CSAI. Full-stack developer, AI specialist, and hardware innovator. Showcased at HITEX 2025.

## About

Ibrahim Hussein is a Computer Engineering student at Salahaddin University-Erbil, specializing in AI development, full-stack web engineering, and embedded systems. He co-founded CSAI (Customer Service AI), which was showcased at HITEX Technology Expo 2025. He builds production-grade applications serving real businesses across Kurdistan.

## Skills & Expertise

- **Languages**: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, C++, HTML/CSS, SQL
- **AI/ML**: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, MediaPipe, scikit-learn, Google Gemini API, NLP
- **Web**: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, TailwindCSS, Three.js, GSAP
- **Backend**: PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, WebSocket, PWA
- **Hardware**: Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, Embedded Systems, IoT
- **Tools**: Git, Docker, Linux, Vercel, Firebase

## Notable Projects

### Chat Mart — Omni-Channel SaaS
Multi-company AI marketplace with 5 messaging channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Viber, Messenger). Features Kurdish TTS voice replies, RBAC with 17+ permissions, reservation system, and PWA.
- URL: https://chat-mart.com
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/chat-mart

### CSAI — Customer Service AI
AI-powered customer service chatbot that understands Kurdish, Arabic, and English. Multi-dialect NLP, real-time responses, multi-provider WhatsApp integration.
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/csai

### Ashti Library
First Kurdish bookstore platform with AI-powered book recommendations via Gemini API, admin dashboard, RTL Kurdish support, and WhatsApp ordering.
- URL: https://ashtilibrary.com
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/ashti-library

### True Prence — Face Recognition Attendance
Face recognition attendance system identifying up to 20 students per frame simultaneously. CNN (GPU) or HOG (CPU) detection, SQLite storage, Excel/PDF exports.
- GitHub: https://github.com/ibrahim-ibo-dev/Attendance-System
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/attendance

### Signed Language Recognition
Real-time gesture recognition using MediaPipe hand/body tracking with custom-trained KNN classifier. Incremental learning, 3x data augmentation, temporal dynamics.
- GitHub: https://github.com/ibrahim-ibo-dev/AI-Sign-Language
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/gestures

### Bradaran & Dyari — Car Dealership Systems
Full car dealership management systems with inventory tracking, customer management, RBAC, PWA, RTL Kurdish interface, and installment tracking.
- Case Study: https://case-study.ibrahim-eng.dev/xara
